title: Push commits
rejected: The remote has commits you don't have: update (pull) first, or turn on "auto-update when rejected" in Git settings.
protected: {target} is a protected branch: force push is off (Git settings).
confirmForce: Force push rewrites {target} on the remote. Press again to confirm.
noRemote: This repository has no remote. Add one under Repository › Remotes, then push.
